title: 서울
sp: Korean Lo-fi Hip Hop. synth pads swell, bass becomes more melodic. Synthesizer pads provide sustained harmonic support in the background, while occasional brass stabs accent the transitions. The drum kit features a crisp, high-tuned snare and a tight, punchy kick drum. The mix is characterized by high-end clarity and a wide stereo field for the backing vocals. The track maintains a consistent dynamic level with minimal structural variation, focusing on the atmospheric repetition of the core loop. 140 BPM, D minor.
